name: Sovereign Apps
description: Pre-alpha modular component template for desktop/mobile pairing and optional Iroh communication modules
lastActionDescription: Added the pinned bridge 0.3 mobile host and optional TCP-forwarder example, updated setup/readiness docs, and passed release gates with Node 22
nextNeeds: Generate bridge 0.3 iOS/Android binaries with Rustup targets and verify host builds
Run QR-to-grant and TCP-forwarder flow on iOS/Android simulators and physical devices
Add minimal local database starter and mobile secure-storage adapter
Run physical pairing, reconnect and revoke evidence
blocking: The checked-in host pins bridge 0.3 source but native binaries require Rustup cross-compilation targets; successful native host build, device evidence, mobile secure storage, and a local database starter remain open

packages.protocol: @sovereign-apps/protocol — versioned framing, signed presence, pairing and LAN discovery
packages.electron-app: @sovereign-apps/electron-app — Electron Iroh responder/dialer, identity, QR and mDNS
packages.react-native-app: @sovereign-apps/react-native-app — React Native Iroh bridge, pairing and LAN browser
packages.ble-bootstrap: @sovereign-apps/ble-bootstrap — bounded BLE bootstrap codec and adapter contracts
packages.offline-bootstrap: @sovereign-apps/offline-bootstrap — deep-link, file/share and NFC handoff contracts
packages.web-presence: @sovereign-apps/web-presence — framework-neutral signed presence with Next.js factories
packages.web-presence-nextjs-example: apps/landing — minimal installable Next.js web-presence example, not a landing

dependencies.@gordo-labs/react-native-iroh: 0.2.0 on npm; mobile host pins public 0.3.0 source as a submodule

protocol.transport: Iroh QUIC with n0 relay + direct hole-punch
